name: text editor
description: Write a short note in GNOME Text Editor with typed text, then open its document statistics.
launch: d=$(mktemp -d); XDG_DATA_HOME=$d XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$d/c XDG_CACHE_HOME=$d/k GSETTINGS_BACKEND=memory exec gnome-text-editor --standalone

steps.text:
# Shopping list

- oat milk
- coffee beans
- lemons
